gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Loose, friendly, hand-lettered shapes up top, with Delius Unicase drawing every curve at a single line weight. And Anek Gurmukhi follows in a plain sans with generous open curves, so a longer passage would read smoothly and without strain.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands tall and squared-off, its terminals stopping well away from the stem, under a heading in Delius Unicase. The handwritten top and modern body sit comfortably together.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-latin: Anek Latin reads in tall lowercase that nearly reaches its capitals, with letters held open rather than curled shut. Anek Latin against the rope-like, unvarying curves of Delius Unicase makes the pair feel relaxed yet orderly.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-malayalam: Hand-drawn and easygoing on top, tidy below. Delius Unicase keeps every stroke uniform, and Anek Malayalam sits close to the capitals in height, with open curve tips, so a long stretch of text would feel light and clean.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-odia: Delius Unicase draws its handwritten letters with the steady line of a technical drafting pen, never thinning at a turn. And Anek Odia's unsealed, hook-like rounds and modest capitals give that friendly hand a clean, contemporary sans-serif partner.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-tamil: Anek Tamil has big round bowls and half-unwrapped shapes. Delius Unicase is best at glowing, neon-tube-consistent strokes with a relaxed handwritten feel, while the body font does its best work being modern and easy to follow.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anek-telugu: Approachable and clean, Anek Telugu sets wide, tall bowls and unsealed rounds beside Delius Unicase, which has no hairlines and no swells anywhere. Hand-lettered charm meets tidy rhythm.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-anuphan: Anuphan reads with big round bowls and clear gaps in its curves. Under Delius Unicase, whose strokes never swell like a pointed brush, a longer passage would feel open, smooth and unhurried.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-arimo: Curves that never thin out at the turns give Delius Unicase its relaxed, handwritten charm. But Arimo, a plain sans with a tall mean line and spacious terminal gaps, is the one that does the steady, professional work of the text.
gen-gf-delius-unicase-gf-armata: Armata reads with spacious gaps between characters, and its lowercase fills most of the letter height. Delius Unicase earns its keep big and short, drawing each stroke like a plotter pen at a single weight.
